ashby:airwallex:b8059bae-1a9e-4f4a-86f2-.summary:
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told…

sections.title: How you'll make impact
paras: As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you’ll be the primary technical owner for a portfolio of Airwallex’s strategic enterprise clients, helping them integrate, adopt, optimise, and scale across our payment solutions. You’ll become a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on each client’s business, architecture, and goals, guiding project and launch planning, resolving operational challenges, and identifying opportunities to improve their experience with Airwallex.
You’ll work from our San Francisco, New York, Toronto, or Seattle office three days a week.
bullets: Own the technical relationship for a portfolio of strategic enterprise clients, helping them integrate, adopt, optimise, and scale across Airwallex’s payment solutions.
Build trusted relationships by developing deep expertise in each client’s business, architecture, goals, and experience with Airwallex products.
Drive successful project and launch planning, post-go-live adoption, and resolution of operational challenges across the customer lifecycle.
Partner with account managers and cross-functional teams across sales, strategy, product, engineering, and support to improve customer outcomes and identify optimisation and expansion opportunities.

Provide an elevated technical support experience by resolving technical questions, serving as an escalation point for break-fix issues, and using customer insight to improve how clients work with Airwallex.

ashby:aleph:20839a2f-b2c7-4e7f-bcc1-d099.summary:

We’re trying to solve a problem many finance teams are super familiar with: data scattered across a million systems, endless spreadsheets and way too much time spent getting numbers to line up instead of actually using them to make decisions.

Aleph was founded by Albert Gozzi and Santiago Perez De Rosso, two technical founders with backgrounds from Stanford and MIT and experience working at top-tier companies such as Google, Microsoft and Bain & Company. We’re backed by top VCs (Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, YC, Picus Capital), and work with customers like Webflow, Notion, Zapier, Y Combinator and many others.

sections.title: About Aleph
paras: We are hiring remotely across the Americas (United States, Canada, LATAM).

sections.title: 🔍 What we're looking for
paras: This is Aleph's first Account Manager hire. You'll own the revenue side of our customer relationships -- renewals, expansions, upsells -- working directly with finance teams who hold vendors to a high standard and can tell the difference between a good pitch and genuine expertise.

You're not walking into a blank slate. We have a CS team that runs deep implementations and customers who are genuinely happy with the product. What we're missing is someone to formalize the renewal and expansion motion, build it into a repeatable playbook, and own it going forward.

That means showing up credibly on two fronts: you can hold a commercial conversation with a CFO, and you can work side by side with our CSMs to spot and develop expansion opportunities across their accounts. You'll report to our Head of Customer Experience and work hand in hand with our CSM team leads and commercial leadership.

bullets: Build the Account Management function from the ground up -- start as a hands-on IC owning the motion yourself, then hire, lead and grow your own team of Account Managers
Own the end-to-end renewal process for a portfolio of accounts, from first health check to signed order form
Formalize our expansion playbook and scale it -- identify where growth potential lives, design the motion, execute it yourself
Partner with CSMs on account strategy; you bring the commercial angle, they bring the implementation depth
Engage directly with finance teams and economic buyers -- understand their workflows, speak their language, and connect Aleph's value to outcomes they actually care about
Track account health signals: usage trends, AI adoption, seat utilization, QBR context
Flag at-risk accounts early and lead save plans with CSMs and leadership -- case by case at first, then turned into a playbook

paras: While this is a remote-first opportunity, we're focusing on candidates within the Americas to better align with our working hours as a team.

ashby:aphex:29d1f350-0190-4812-9728-7154.summary:
We're the construction coordination platform that's replacing outdated spreadsheets with multiplayer tools that delivery teams love. Major contractors like Elis Don, Aecon, Bird and Mace use Aphex to deliver their projects ranging from $50 million to multi-billion dollar mega projects. Since launching in 2019, we've grown to become the market-leading solution in the UK and Australia, with aspirations to be where every major project in the world is planned and delivered.

We're now expanding into North America — this is a founding role, joining some of the team relocating from our London office to launch the new office. We've already got clients on major infrastructure projects around Toronto, and strong product-market fit proven in three other markets. Your job is to help major contractors get genuine value out of Aphex on their live projects. You'll be in the room and on site with planners, engineers, construction managers, and project directors, helping them embed weekly planning routines, daily coordination, and the reporting that makes their projects run better.

Drive daily coordination. Move teams from weekly planning into the daily routines that make site coordination genuinely better.
Build trusted relationships across the project. Engineers, supervisors, planners, project managers, construction managers and superintendents. Hold real credibility at every level.
Monitor project health and act on it. Track signals, spot risks early, run plays to fix issues before they escalate.
Spot what isn't working and fix it. Process gaps, missing resources, awkward workflows. We hire people who don't wait to be asked.
Help shape the North America playbook as one of the first people on the ground.

paras: You'll be a founding member of the North America Customer Success Hub, learning directly alongside experienced CSMs relocating from our UK team to launch the office. You'll learn by working live deployments with them, not from a training course.

You'll also work closely with our North America sales team to understand how project success translates into account growth, and collaborate with our UK and APAC hubs on shared accounts, knowledge sharing, and the global playbook we run across regions.

ashby:atticus:d2996efc-c8b0-4b9c-a840-c8.summary:
At any given time, 16 million Americans are experiencing a crisis that requires urgent help from our legal system or government. The right assistance could transform their lives. But today, most never get it.

Atticus makes it easy for any sick or injured American to get life-changing aid. Our mission is to tear down barriers between people in crisis and the aid they deserve. In the last six years, we’ve become the leading platform connecting people with disabilities to government benefits.

We also help victims of accidents, misconduct, and violence get compensation from insurance. So far, we’ve helped hundreds of thousands of people access over $10 billion in life-changing aid —and earned over 20,000 five-star reviews. And we’re just getting started.

sections.title: About Atticus
paras: We've raised more than $100 million from top VC firms like Forerunner, Google Ventures, and True Ventures, and we’re on our way to creating a category defining business assisting Americans in need.

sections.title: The Job
paras: Each day, hundreds of people seek our help getting disability benefits or insurance compensation. They’re intimidated by the process, unsure where to turn, and desperate for good advice.

As part of our Client Experience team, your job is to get them on the right path. You’ll spend each day communicating on the phone with clients to understand their situation, figure out whether we can help them, and advise them on the next steps. You'll become an expert on a complex and interesting field, learn to rapidly navigate our internal tech platforms and tools (Salesforce, etc.), and help hundreds of ordinary people (each with a unique story) every week. You’ll be measured by and compensated for the impact you have on our clients.

This job is different from traditional customer service or sales: Our service is totally free, and clients are desperate for our help — so you'll rarely talk to an angry customer. The conversations are deeply rewarding, and clients are profoundly grateful. You will have to navigate conversations on deeply personal and sad topics, gently but quickly offer guidance, and handle many different interactions over the course of a day.

sections.title: Qualifications
paras: We are strongly committed to building a diverse team. If you’re from a background that’s underrepresented in tech, we’d love to meet you.
bullets: You have a Bachelor’s degree from a four-year university with strong academic performance.
You have at least 1 year of working experience outside of internships (longer internships to be considered).
You care about people and can interact with folks from all walks of life; you’re able to simultaneously be supportive to a person in crisis and quickly drive a conversation.
You’re a quick learner and a competent writer, able to master complex new topics and platforms when given instruction and support.
You have a strong work ethic and are capable of juggling multiple competing priorities.
You’ve previously worked at a high volume, high-performing service/sales/support team from a company known for great customer service.
You have completed a socially-focused, hands-on internship or have significant volunteer experience.

sections.title: Location
paras: This job is fully remote and we’re committed to empowering everyone with flexibility. We care a lot about building a great culture and we think some interactions need to happen in person, so we put a lot of thought into retreats, offsites, and other ways to gather.

ashby:aurelian:add5cdef-328f-4e04-a42a-0.summary:
Aurelian builds AI tools that help 911 centers handle more with less, so telecommunicators can stay focused on what matters most and communities get the response they need.

AVA is a conversational AI agent that answers non-emergency calls; the agent routes, triages, and resolves the calls without any human intervention. By handling administrative calls like noise complaints, lost dogs, and parking inquiries, AVA eliminates hold times and lets call-takers focus their energy on actual emergencies.

CORA supports call-takers on the calls that matter most. CORA is an on-screen assistant that delivers real-time SOP checklists, smart reminders, and contextual guidance as an emergency call unfolds, so dispatchers stay calm, consistent, and confident when every second counts. When AVA detects an emergency mid-call, it transfers the caller to a telecommunicator and passes along the caller…

sections.title: About Aurelian
paras: The problem we're solving is serious. The average emergency communications center is 30% understaffed nationwide. Staffing shortages drive burnout and attrition, which makes the shortage worse. Meanwhile, 60-80% of the calls coming in aren't even emergencies at all. Aurelian addresses both sides of that equation: AVA reduces unnecessary call volume, and CORA makes every emergency call more manageable for the people handling it.

Aurelian is live in centers across the country, answering thousands of non-emergency calls every day, and is backed by New Enterprise Associates and Y Combinator . Aurelian is growing rapidly; we are hiring people who want to help scale this work and make a real difference in public safety infrastructure for communities across the country.

sections.title: What You’ll Be Doing
bullets: You will own a product area, not a single feature.

You will help define the roadmap, not execute an existing one - you will talk with customers, founders, and engineers daily to figure out what to build next and do whatever it takes to serve their needs.

You will work across every business function: You’ll work closely with engineers to prototype and ship products, marketers and AEs to figure out the right angle and pain points to highlight, and implementation specialists to strategize on rollout. Nothing is beyond your scope to drive a product to completion.

sections.title: Who We’re Looking For
paras: To learn more about what it's like to work at Aurelian, visit our About Us page and follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date!

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed above. We believe exceptional people come from many different backgrounds, and we’d rather connect with you than miss the opportunity.
Come do the best work of your life and join us in shaping the future of critical technology that truly matters.

ashby:delinea:73fe12a3-d21b-4e3c-ad9b-03.summary:
About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken.

You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved.

sections.title: The opportunity
bullets: Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Loancrate builds AI-native tooling to automate mortgage workflows. Our ultimate goal is fully automated origination, which has the potential to save over $16B per year. Since starting in 2020, our remote team has enabled our customers to power >$85 billion in new home loans.

We care about collaboration, open communication covering the good and the bad so that we learn from our decisions quickly, and ultimately having fun while we're building. You'll fit in well if you like diving deep quickly.

paras: We're looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager who thrives on complexity, moves fast, and wants their work to actually matter. You'll own a product area end-to-end - embedded with a world-class Engineering team, in constant contact with customers, and making real decisions about what gets built. This isn't a role where you manage a backlog and write tickets. You'll be setting direction, and people will follow it.

Home lending is a $2 trillion market still running on software built before the iPhone existed. AI is fundamentally changing what's possible, and Loancrate is executing seriously at that intersection. Our Engineering team is fast, senior, and deeply product-minded - the problems are genuinely hard, the stakes are high, and the work you ship will touch billions of dollars in home loans.

You're the type of PM who gets energy from being close to the customer and close to the code. You have enough technical depth that engineers want your input on architecture - whether that's from a stint as a software engineer, a habit of prototyping your ideas, or genuine fluency with the systems you're building on. sections.title: Your Role
bullets: You are the first product manager for GTM AI within Enterprise AI & Technology, owning the tools and agents that reach Field GTM & Operations, and the productivity and revenue gains they deliver.

You think AI-first and bring the ideas no one asked for: a seller gets a researched account brief, not a faster form. You prove the non-obvious idea with a cheap prototype, and you are equally clear about where AI does not belong.

You work directly with the business. You sit with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales Ops to learn how the work really gets done, then write what gets built — the process flow, the data flow, the spec, the success criteria — and prototype it, so our GTM engineers build the right thing the first time.

You look at the whole picture, mapping the end-to-end flow across teams, systems, and handoffs before committing to a build, so we connect the revenue journey rather than ship point solutions that leave seams everywhere.
You define the approach where no playbook exists, balancing speed, quality, and adoption, and you set up the intake, prioritization, and release process for a function that did not have one.

You hold the quality bar personally, getting hands-on with the data, the prompts, the evals, and the agent workflows, because an AI capability the field cannot trust is worse than no capability at all.

sections.title: You Will
bullets: Run discovery with sellers, marketers, customer success managers, and Sales Ops: shadow the work, find where time and deals are lost, set a productivity baseline, and turn requests into clear problems, priorities, and success criteria.
Own the roadmap and backlog for a portfolio of GTM AI capabilities, deciding with the GTM engineers what to build, what to configure, and what to say no to.

Own the GTM AI estate, not just the roadmap: evaluate and test vendors, make the build-versus-buy call and brief leadership on it, consolidate surfaces so the field has fewer places to go, and keep one source of truth for active and planned use cases.

Write the specs and prototypes the GTM engineers build from — example inputs, expected outputs, acceptance tests, integrations, and data flows — and turn them into reusable patterns, so each use case ships faster than the last.
Design AI experiences that turn signals into recommendations and automated action, not dashboards, with the reliability, security, and privacy requirements set up front.
Define and track adoption, usage, time saved, and ROI for each capability, and act on what they tell you, including retiring what does not work.

Decide what runs autonomously and what keeps a human in the loop — being able to automate something is not a reason to — then set the approval gates, evals, and quality checks that keep agent outputs trustworthy in front of customers and sellers.

Partner with Data and Engineering on the foundations behind GTM AI — entity resolution, enrichment, and scoring inputs from Salesforce, Gong, Clay, and Snowflake — and give every context source feeding the GTM AI outputs a named owner and a refresh cadence.

sections.title: Qualifications

Strong GTM domain credibility: you know how Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Sales Ops work day to day, you are comfortable with sellers and their leaders, and you have improved sales productivity through product, automation and AI.

A builder's mindset: comfortable starting from an imperfect prototype, a track record of turning ambiguous needs into specs and workflows that get built and used, and judgment about where LLMs and agents fail and how to evaluate them.
Fluency with the GTM stack — Salesforce, Gong, Clay, Snowflake, and LLM tools such as Claude — plus CRM data models, APIs, and workflow orchestration.

Hands-on AI build skill: you have personally built working prototypes, agents, or automated workflows with tools such as Claude Code, not just used AI-enabled products, and you can show what you built, what broke, and what you changed.

sections.title: About the Customer Digital Experience Team
paras: Customer Digital Experience sits within the technical arm of Mixpanel's Customer Success organization.

Our sharpest focus is the digital-only segment: thousands of companies with no proactive account coverage. Some have technical resources available to them, but that support is entirely reactive. It answers the ticket and solves the problem in front of it. Nobody is watching for the customer who implemented and then never built a report, or the account whose usage has been sliding for a month. Our job is to be proactive,, and everything we build should be as automated as possible, without a human initiating it.

Our programs run across the full customer base and are not one-size-fits-all. We build flows that branch and adapt by segment, tuning the content, timing, and channel for who's receiving them. An onboarding flow for a digital-only customer carries the whole experience; the version reaching an account with a dedicated team is tuned to complement what that team is already doing. Same underlying program, deliberately different execution, continuously optimized based on what each segment responds to.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: As our Digital Adoption & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own the communications that drive adoption, retention, and expansion across Mixpanel's customer base, with our digital-only customers as the sharpest test of whether the programs work. You'll design lifecycle programs triggered by real behavior: a team that just implemented but hasn't built their first report, an account whose query volume dropped for three straight weeks, a power user hitting the edge of their current plan. Then you'll write the emails and in-product messages that move them forward.
This is a builder's role, not a maintainer's role. You'll define the segmentation, write the copy, set up the triggers, instrument the measurement, and then argue with the data about what to change.

It's also a deeply collaborative one. You'll work hand in hand with our Customer Success Digital Programs Manager, sharing a roadmap and dividing the work. You'll partner with Marketing on the overall email calendar so our lifecycle sends and their campaigns aren't competing for the same inbox. You'll support adoption initiatives coming out of Product, turning a launch into something customers actually try. And you'll take cues from customer-facing teams about what's landing and what isn't. Very little of this job happens alone.

Design behavior-based segmentation using product usage, health signals, lifecycle stage, and account attributes; define the triggers that decide who hears from us and when
Write clear, useful customer-facing copy across email, in-product messaging, and other digital channels that reflects Mixpanel's voice and gives customers a reason to act
Build and ship campaigns in tools like Customer.io, HubSpot, and Statisfy, including the audience logic, templates, and QA that keep them reliable
Partner with Marketing on the shared email calendar, coordinating timing, frequency, and audience overlap so customers get a coherent experience instead of three messages in one week
Support product-led adoption initiatives by translating launches and feature pushes into lifecycle moments that get customers to try the thing, and report back on whether they did

Optimize Value Frameworks: Enhance our library of reusable benchmarks and modeling templates, directly improving the efficiency and accuracy of the global sales organization’s value-selling efforts.

Translate Technical Impact: Convert technical performance metrics into clear commercial language, delivering executive-level summaries that simplify complex purchasing decisions for C-suite stakeholders.

greenhouse:queracomputinginc:5479905008.summary: QuEra develops quantum hardware, software tools, and educational resources to advance the understanding and use of neutral atom fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC). We are seeking a Technical Product Manager with knowledge of FTQC to own the user experience of our Quantum Enablement Platform, serving our partners, collaborators, and the broader quantum computing community.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Your goal will be to define and deliver a product vision that helps users progress from learning about FTQC and neutral atom quantum computing to exploring QuEra’s capabilities and designing experiments for our systems. You will draw on your expertise in quantum computing and product development to work closely with scientists, software engineers, and other product managers, translating user feedback and advances in QuEra’s software and hardware into clear product priorities. You will also prepare the platform for AI-enabled learning workflows, helping users explore concepts, navigate resources, and apply what they learn with the support of AI assistants.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Shape product planning: Work alongside scientists, software engineers, and other product managers to define the Quantum Enablement Platform vision, roadmap, and priorities.

Define product requirements and priorities: Collect and analyze usage data, learning outcomes, and user feedback to identify improvements. Translate these insights and advances in QuEra’s hardware and software into clear platform requirements.

Improve the learning experience: Help users progress from understanding quantum computing concepts to exploring QuEra’s capabilities and designing experiments, including through AI-enabled learning workflows.
Develop educational offerings: Identify gaps in educational content and interactive tooling, and work with our internal experts to address them.
Coordinate updates and releases: Plan platform updates, track dependencies, and coordinate testing, content reviews, and release materials.
Inform software interfaces: Analyze user behavior and feedback from the platform to identify usability gaps and help software development teams improve interfaces and workflows.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Professional experience managing a user-facing online platform, including gathering user feedback, prioritizing improvements, and coordinating ongoing updates.
Substantial experience designing or improving AI-assisted workflows, with an understanding of how users use AI tools to explore technical concepts, navigate resources, and apply what they learn.
Foundational knowledge of quantum error correction and FTQC, with the ability to explain technical concepts to audiences with different levels of expertise.
Ability to collect and analyze usage data and user feedback to assess user needs, recommend improvements, and define clear requirements and priorities.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, physics, engineering, chemistry, or a related technical field.

sections.title: Preferred Qualifications
paras: The approximate base salary range for this position is $120,400 - $180,400.

We consistently monitor external market data and update base salary ranges accordingly. We determine base compensation decisions on several factors, including as geographic placement, role-specific knowledge, skills, and/or experience. In addition to our base salary offerings, we also provide equity grants for all new hires.
bullets: Experience creating technical documentation, tutorials, interactive demonstrations, or workshops for quantum computing or scientific software.
Experience developing or managing educational platforms, including evaluating learning outcomes and user engagement.
Experience with neutral atom quantum computing.
Graduate-level study in a relevant technical field, or technology management.

paras: We’re looking for an experienced Senior Technical Implementation Partner - Inpatient Capacity to join our Delivery team. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in end-to-end delivery of technical features and functions to ensure successful and timely enterprise-scale software deployments. You’ll work cross-functionally with key leaders and users in the hospital including the executive sponsors, care coordinators, nurses, physicians, and IT Teams to shape solutions that deliver measurable value.
This is a high-impact role that will influence our Inpatient Capacity solution, strengthen customer outcomes, and shape our company’s growth trajectory.

sections.title: Key Responsibilities
bullets: Define and manage the timeline for enterprise-wide, multi-module deployments, with an initial focus on the Qventus Inpatient Capacity solution.
Work with Data Integration Specialists, Clinical Operation Consultants, and Product Specialists throughout each deployment to identify and implement solutions that deliver client value.
Collaborate with external client teams to understand evolving requirements/needs and communicate potential approaches to address them.
Leverage deep functional Inpatient expertise to create and sustain buy-in from core users, executives, and care coordinators around workflows and tool adoption

Build and manage relationships at multiple levels of client organizations, from frontline staff to C-suite stakeholders.
Identify and mitigate risks and advise Delivery team leaders on project opportunities and risks, driving any issues to resolution.
Identify process improvement opportunities and create structured approaches to close gaps.

bullets: 5+ years of experience in project/program management experience with a comprehensive understanding of the business requirements and technical capabilities needed for an enterprise-wide SaaS implementation.
5+ years professional experience working at a top healthcare consulting firm, digital health company, or health system.
5+ years working cross-functionally with multiple teams, both internally & externally, to manage end-to-end project lifecycles and to drive project milestones to completion.
Previous experience working with Epic integrations and build. Specifically certification in IP Orders, IP ClinDoc, Ambulatory or related modules/applications.

Proven track record in applying strong quantitative and analytical skills in prior hospital systems (eg. EHR implementations) and project management with complex implementations in the provider-side health setting.
Deep domain knowledge in Inpatient metrics, processes, challenges, and solutions; ability to engage in strategic/operational discussions with hospital leaders and surgeons
Strong communicator with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels.
Hands-on experience and proficiency with tools such as data validation dashboards, interpreting JAVA/SQL code, complex Excel functions, etc.

Experience with HL7/FHIR integrations.
Experience working with clinical and/or process consultants.
PMP Certification.

greenhouse:samsara:8236004.summary: Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

sections.title: Total Rewards
paras: At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

sections.title: Flexible Working
paras: At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Lead the prioritization of work and manage requests by examining costs and benefits while maintaining positive and candid relationships with stakeholders.

sections.title: STARLINK ACCOUNT MANAGER (US FEDERAL)
paras:
Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, is delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world. The Account Management team serves as the point of contact for customers from contract signature, through successful activation, ensuring all contract terms are fulfilled while and identifying new opportunities to generate business with enterprise customers. Prior to contract signature, the team will have a key role in ensuring that the commitments we make are ones we can successfully execute to.

In the past year, the Starlink team has signed contracts with customers who will deploy high speed internet at a pace and for use cases previously not possible. The team has designed the product to be self-service, and we need to similarly evolve our team and systems to enable large enterprises to manage Starlink themselves, minimizing humans-in-the-loop. Our ideal candidate is a self-starter that has a passion for making customers deliriously happy, supporting excellent teams, and managing complex cross-functional projects.

sections.title: RESPONSIBILITIES:
bullets: Act as the primary point of contact for a robust portfolio of assigned federal government customers and own the interface from contract signature onwards (onboarding, ongoing account management, and long-term retention/growth of the relationship and revenue) with emphasis on:
Delivering impeccable customer service, including efficient acknowledgement and resolution of issues
Building relationships to identify requirements and manage expectations
Collecting, communicating, and championing customer feedback internally to influence and steer programmatic and technical development required to maintain and grow enterprise business
Retaining and growing the value of accounts
As an extreme owner of assigned accounts, identify and successfully communicate readiness levels, requirements, schedules, and risks to realize forecasted revenue on or ahead of schedule

Serve as the team’s internal expert in the federal and civilian government vertical in specific regions, shaping strategic direction and routinely leading high-impact commercial decision-making within the vertical and region in partnership with other teams
Autonomously identify, design, and lead implementation of new processes and system improvements that will broadly accelerate growth for customers or enable the internal team to scale rapidly

sections.title: BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
bullets: Bachelor's degree; OR high school diploma/equivalency certificate and 5+ years of professional business development, operations, engineering, or account management experience
4+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or business operations
1+ years of experience working with government customers

sections.title: PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
bullets: 3+ years of experience working with customers to support a technical product/service
3+ years working with US federal or civil government customers
Significant knowledge or experience in one or more of the following industries: federal, public sector, telecommunications, manufacturing, satellite communications and/or supply chain
Experience managing multiple complex projects and delivering under tight deadlines and resource constraints
Experience building long-term and successful customer relationships demonstrating empathy, active listening, and resiliency skills
Significant technical knowledge of Starlink or telecommunications in at least one key area: satellites, ground network, user terminals, or related technology
Ability to synthesize multiple unique requirements and suggest smart solutions, products, or features
Track record of demonstrating sound business judgement, evaluating alternatives, and making recommendations that were adopted and ultimately successful

sections.title: Create a Welcoming, Well-Maintained Workplace
paras: As a Client Services Associate / Floor Ambassador , you will help maintain a clean, organized, and professional office environment for employees and visitors. This role supports daily office operations through mail and package distribution, conference room preparation, pantry and restroom upkeep, and general facilities assistance.

You will play an important role in ensuring that workplace services run smoothly while responding to employee requests and coordinating with management, Facilities, IT, and third-party vendors when additional support is needed.

sections.title: Why This Role Matters
paras: A well-maintained workplace helps employees stay productive and creates a positive experience for everyone who visits the office. Through attention to detail, proactive service, and consistent follow-through, you will help keep daily operations organized, office spaces presentable, and essential supplies readily available.

sections.title: What You'll Do

Routinely check outgoing package bins and coordinate their delivery to the mailroom for processing.

Inspect conference rooms to ensure chairs are properly arranged, tables are clean, and rooms are meeting-ready.
Set up conference rooms according to meeting requirements and restore them after meetings.

Good communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with employees, visitors, and management.

greenhouse:stripe:8122188.summary:
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet.

Stripe Apps connect Stripe with the tools businesses already use, bringing relevant data and workflows into the Stripe Dashboard and third-party systems. The Strategic Apps team owns a portfolio of integrations with enterprise systems that are critical to our users’ workflows—from quote-to-cash and support to reporting. We help users embed Stripe more deeply into the way they run their businesses.

sections.title: What you’ll do
paras: We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to set the strategy and lead execution for Strategic Apps. You will own a portfolio of existing and new integrations, including those with systems such as Salesforce, and determine where Stripe should invest based on user needs, Stripe’s product and industry priorities, and market signals. You will work across Stripe and directly with external partners to deliver reliable, high-quality integrations that drive adoption and business outcomes.
bullets: Own the vision, product strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a portfolio of strategic apps, making and communicating clear trade-offs amid significant ambiguity.
Identify, prioritize, and validate the highest-value user problems and integration opportunities through direct user research, ecosystem analysis, and quantitative evidence.

Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Sales, User Support, Marketing, Partner Management, and other product teams to deliver and evolve integrations end to end.

Partner with Engineering to define product requirements, technical approach, and quality standards for integrations, including APIs, documentation, edge cases, reliability, security, compliance, and ongoing maintenance.

Establish feedback loops and measurement plans before launch; use product, business, and user metrics to assess efficacy, diagnose changes in performance, and continuously improve adoption, retention, and revenue outcomes.

Represent Stripe’s product strategy with strategic technology partners and enterprise users, building productive relationships with product and technical counterparts and incorporating their feedback into roadmap decisions.

Drive launches, beta programs, user acceptance testing, and go-to-market readiness in partnership with Marketing, Sales, Partner Management, and Support; ensure teams have the materials and operating model needed to support adoption at scale.
Make and drive important cross-functional decisions, align senior stakeholders around a shared strategy, and communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly.

sections.title: Minimum requirements
bullets: 8+ years of relevant product-management, engineering, or equivalent experience, including ownership of a high-quality product or feature area at scale or a major evolution of an existing product.
Experience setting product strategy and driving execution across multiple cross-functional teams or a complex product area, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and iteration.
Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative evidence to define success metrics, evaluate product performance, and make prioritization decisions.
Strong technical judgment and fluency working with engineers on API-based products, integrations, technical constraints, and product quality.
Experience engaging directly with enterprise users and external technology partners, and translating their needs into clear product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and leading through organizational boundaries.

sections.title: Preferred qualifications
bullets: Experience with enterprise business systems and workflows, such as CRM, ERP, quote-to-cash, support, or reporting platforms; familiarity with Salesforce, Oracle, SAP, or Microsoft Dynamics is a plus.
Experience building or scaling platform, ecosystem, marketplace, or partner-integrated products.
Experience growing product adoption, usage, or revenue through product-led and go-to-market initiatives.
Experience in payments, financial technology, or other regulated technology environments.
A degree in computer science, engineering, or another technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

greenhouse:stripe:8331124.summary: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

sections.title: About the team
paras: Our Product Marketing team's mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe's product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation and Campaigns to name a few. Different from many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle, from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption post-launch.
We are looking to hire a Product Marketing Manager to own end-to-end go-to-market strategy for Stripe Subscriptions to help businesses build, launch, and scale recurring revenue models.

sections.title: What you'll do
paras: As a Product Marketing Manager for Subscriptions, you will set the go-to-market strategy for our subscription management offerings, translating customer needs and market dynamics into positioning, launches, and programs that drive adoption and growth.
bullets: Set go-to-market strategy — Build and own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for subscription management offerings, defining target audiences, priority use cases, routes to market, and measures of success.

Champion the customer — Develop deep insight into the needs of businesses with recurring revenue models through customer research, market analysis, and close partnership with user-facing teams; translate those insights into product and commercial recommendations.

Shape positioning and messaging — Create clear, differentiated narratives that make complex billing and monetization capabilities accessible and compelling to businesses ranging from startups to global enterprises.

Lead product launches — Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, and Demand Generation to bring new capabilities to market, coordinating launch plans and enabling teams to deliver a consistent customer experience.

Drive adoption and growth — Design and execute programs that increase awareness, activation, and sustained usage across priority customer segments, using data and experimentation to improve performance.
Enable customer-facing teams — Equip Sales and other user-facing teams with the insights, content, and tools they need to communicate value, navigate customer needs, and accelerate adoption.
Measure and optimize impact — Define goals and success metrics, synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals, and turn results into actionable recommendations for product and go-to-market teams.

sections.title: Who you are
paras: We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

sections.title: Minimum requirements
bullets: 7+ years of product marketing or growth marketing experience at a technology company, with a track record of independently owning end-to-end go-to-market strategy and execution.
Experience marketing complex B2B software, financial technology, billing, payments, or other products that require translating technical concepts into clear customer value.
Demonstrated ability to develop positioning and messaging, lead product launches, and drive adoption across multiple customer segments.
Strong customer orientation and analytical judgment, with experience combining research, market insight, and performance data to shape strategy and influence product decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling narratives for executive, technical, sales, and customer audiences.
Proven cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence and deliver results across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams.

greenhouse:submittable:6236293004.summary:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs , welcomed 1.2 million applicants , and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.

We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.

sections.title: About the role
paras: The Customer Success Manager is the primary point of contact for an assigned group of Submittable clients, building trusted advisor partnerships that connect Submittable’s value to each client’s business goals. The role builds tailored Success Plans, leads regular Business Reviews, and helps clients grow their programs on the platform.
The Customer Success Manager partners with Account Executives, Technical Support, and other Submittable teams to resolve client needs and identify opportunities for expansion.

sections.title: Key responsibilities
bullets: Build trusted advisor partnerships with assigned clients, aligning Submittable’s value to each client’s key and overarching business goals.
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, bringing in Submittable resources such as Account Executives or Technical Support as needed.
Build long-term business relationships by following through on commitments and responding to client needs promptly.

Evaluate client program priorities and create tailored Success Plans with clear goals and milestones, identifying barriers to program growth and recommending strategies based on client research and industry knowledge.
Schedule and conduct Business Reviews to track Success Plan progress and identify opportunities for additional gains as they arise.
Identify opportunities for Account Executives to expand Submittable’s footprint through new features, services, and instances.
Recommend improvements to Submittable’s business, products, and client approach based on client feedback.
Keep accurate, up-to-date client records in Salesforce.

sections.title: Skills & Competencies
paras: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Compensation: The base salary range for this role is $70,000–$80,000 per year. The role also includes variable compensation, on an 80/20 base-to-variable split. At target performance, total on-target earnings (OTE) are $87,500–$100,000 . The final base salary will depend on the candidate’s job-related experience, skills and qualifications.

We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States; however, we cannot accommodate scholastic or employment visas at this time . In addition, we are not able to consider applicants who reside in the following states: Alaska, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maine, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington, West Virginia, and Wyoming.
bullets: 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, customer success, or account management.
Experience recognizing sales and expansion opportunities within existing client accounts.
Learns new software quickly and explains technical product functionality clearly to clients.
Communicates clearly in writing and in conversation with client stakeholders at all levels.
Organizes work across multiple accounts and competing priorities, meeting deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
Adjusts plans and approach as client needs and priorities change.
Keeps detailed, accurate records of client activity and commitments.
Experience using a CRM to manage client records; Salesforce experience preferred.

sections.title: Why Submittable?
paras: Joining Submittable means becoming part of a forward-thinking, mission-driven company that values innovation, collaboration, and growth. We empower organizations working for social good with technology that accelerates their work, amplifies their impact, and drives meaningful change.

At Submittable, you’ll find a supportive, dynamic work environment where your contributions directly influence our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and are excited to be part of a company dedicated to social impact, we invite you to apply!
Benefits: We are proud to offer highly competitive benefits to our full-time employees, including:
bullets: Comprehensive health and life insurance with optional HSA, FSA, and DCA accounts
401(k) plan with employer match starting day one
Equity stock options to share in our success
Flexible hours, remote work options, and generous vacation and sick leave
Paid parental leave for mothers, fathers, and adoptive parents
Professional development stipends to support your career growth
Opportunities to participate in community outreach and volunteer programs
Monthly company-sponsored happy hours and gatherings to connect and unwind

greenhouse:tegnainc:5241937007.summary:
TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

The Account Manager supports Account Executives’ sales efforts by taking ownership of fulfillment in such a way that the AE can play their role of being client-facing, creating opportunities and closing revenue. The Account Manager manages the day-to-day responsibilities of accounts to ensure proper implementation of their solutions. The Account Manager influences and drives sales by providing superior customer service and support across Broadcast Television and Digital, aiming at retaining clients and growing business. This job reports to…

sections.title: About TEGNA
bullets: Provide support to assigned Account Executives on post-sale activity including campaign implementation, maintenance, and review.

Daily interaction with existing advertising agencies and direct clients; this responsibility includes maintenance of client schedules on television and digital in addition to implementation of special projects and promotions.
Works in tandem with Account Executives, Marketing Director, Research Director, and Creative Services to support client needs.
Attend sales meetings and sales trainings to gain sales, product and process information and keep abreast of company products and services to articulate to client, when appropriate.
Partner with designated Account Executives in identifying new/incremental revenue based on campaign results.
Assist designated Account Executives with maintenance of contracts, generating avails, traffic, make-goods, collection and overall customer service.
Regular tracking of clients’ audience delivery using ratings, impressions, clients KPIs, and campaign fulfillment.
Coordinate with team to set up new customer accounts, contracts, order entry and revisions.

greenhouse:toast:8363046.summary:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast International is building its upmarket business across the UK & Ireland, Canada, and Australia, focused on restaurant groups with 16 to 500 locations. We're hiring a solutions lead to own the technical side of every International deal over 15 locations. Your demos and labs are where our deals are won or lost.

sections.title: A day in the life (Responsibilities)
paras: All of it within what's actually available, and what payments rules allow, in each market.
bullets: Run labs that end in a decision. Agree success criteria with the customer before the lab starts. Build and maintain the lab environment, track every issue, drive escalations and root cause analysis, and close the lab with a clear yes or no. No lab ends without an agreed next step.
Own the technical outcome through go-live. The deal isn't won until the customer is live and it matches what we sold. Stay involved through procurement and handoff.
Architect the solution. Design how Toast fits into a multi-location group's existing stack:
Lead security, IT and compliance reviews. Own vendor security questionnaires, PCI scoping conversations and the technical sections of RFPs.

Speak product's language. Write business requirement documentation that product and engineering can act on: the problem, the customer's own words, workarounds tried, what's at stake across the segment (not just one account), and options with tradeoffs. Turn one customer's ask into a case for the platform.
Present the roadmap with credibility. Walk executive and IT audiences through what exists, what's coming and what isn't, without overpromising. Keep their trust when the answer is "not yet."
Engineer workarounds, and know when to hold the line. Design and document solutions to complex gaps, and judge when a workaround creates debt we'll pay for at go-live.
Build real relationships outside the sales thread. Become the trusted counterpart to the customer's IT lead, head of operations and systems owners, relationships that hold up on their own merit.

sections.title: What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)
bullets: An elite demo and lab track record. You've run tailored demos for multi-stakeholder buying committees and taken complex labs or pilots to a signed decision. In the interview, you'll run a demo for us and walk us through a lab you ran end to end.
You build and maintain your own environments. Demo data, lab configurations and resets are your job, done fast and adapted for each market.
7+ years in solutions architecture, solutions engineering or technical consulting, with at least 4 supporting mid-market or enterprise deals with 6 to 12+ month cycles and buying committees.
Experience in hospitality, retail or payments technology serving multi-location operators.
You've taken complex deals through lab or pilot to go-live. You can walk us through one end to end, including what went wrong and what you changed.

Integration fluency: REST APIs, webhooks, authentication and data flows. You can read API docs and sketch an architecture on a whiteboard. Coding isn't required, but you can test your own assumptions.
Security and compliance fluency: PCI DSS scope, and privacy regimes such as UK GDPR, PIPEDA and the Australian Privacy Act. You're comfortable owning a security review.
Writing that product teams act on. Bring a sanitized requirements doc, solution design or BRD to the interview.

sections.title: Special Skills (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)
bullets: Hands-on experience with enterprise POS or hospitality platforms in these markets
ERP, HR or workforce management integration experience

sections.title: What success looks like in year one
bullets: Every 16+ location deal gets a tailored demo, and every lab has agreed success criteria and ends in a decision.
Deals we win go live on the timeline we agreed. No stalls, no churn, no post-sale surprises.
AEs know exactly when and how to bring you in, and technical fit is settled early in the cycle, not in week ten.
Product changes a decision because of a BRD you wrote.
A clear plan for the next upmarket solutions hire.

greenhouse:toshibaglobalcommercesolution.summary: Note: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work in the United States without a need for current or future visa sponsorship .

sections.title: Must be located near or within the Raleigh-Durham area.
paras: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a Product Manager in our Software Portfolio Organization and have ownership of a defined area within the ELERA Commerce Suite, our flagship software offering. You will be reporting to a Sr Manager | ELERA Portfolio Owner and work closely with other Product Managers to bring our ELERA solutions to several of the Top 10 Largest Global Retailers and to the greater retail market beyond.

You will own the business justifications and market positioning for one-to-many offerings within the ELERA Portfolio — capabilities designed once and delivered to many retailers. That translates to finding the patterns across what individual customers ask for, deciding which needs are common enough to belong in our product, and making the case for the investment behind them.

You will own the WHAT and the WHY behind our product strategy. The WHAT is the product itself: the capabilities that belong in ELERA, the roadmap that carries them forward, and the priorities that decide what gets built first. The WHY is the reasoning that earns them — the customer problem being solved, the market opportunity, the competitive position, and the value created for retailers and for Toshiba. You will carry both to customers, sales, and to our executive team, and you will be the person who can articulate and defend the position and negotiate where necessary.

sections.title: Responsibilities
bullets: Engage retailers, sales, partners, and market research directly to understand the business problems behind what customers ask for — and frame those problems rather than simply receive them.
Generalize across customers. Identify the patterns that make a capability worth building once and delivering to many and distinguish those from work that is specific to a single retailer.
Own the business justification for your offerings — opportunity, value, competitive position, and sizing — and present and defend it through portfolio prioritization.
Define market positioning and value propositions for your offerings, and partner with marketing, sales, and services to carry them to market.
Own and maintain the roadmap and backlog for your offerings, including the prioritization decisions and the tradeoffs behind them.

Author the Business Requirements Document for each product direction you set, covering the WHAT and the WHY, customer and market insights and transcripts, relevant background, assumptions and exclusions, user story breakdown, and acceptance criteria.

Create a working clickable prototype for each product direction, directing AI design and development tooling against our codebase so that engineering and stakeholders can see your intent rather than infer it from a document.
Partner with engineering through the build, clarifying intent as questions arise and confirming that what gets delivered reflects the business case you made.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of experience, or equivalent combination.
Demonstrated ownership of a product, product area, or major business problem, with accountability for business outcomes rather than for defining or delivering a feature list
A track record of defining product direction from customer and market evidence, including examples where you decided what not to build
Substantial written work product — requirements, business cases, or product strategy documents you personally authored
Experience working directly with enterprise customers and with senior internal stakeholders, including the ability to hold a position under pressure and negotiate to a decision

Hands-on use of AI tooling to produce real work products, with specific examples of what you made and how. Articulate specific examples of product requirements and UX prototyping through the use of AI.
Evidence that you teach yourself new capability on your own initiative. This matters more to us than any particular tool on your resume because the tooling will change again.
8+ years in product management and demonstrated product ownership and accountability

sections.title: Preferred
paras:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self-checkout at Lowe's Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ's, or Costco? These are just a few examples of our in-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader.

The nature of retail is changing quickly, so if you share our 'Together Commerce' vision of a seamless two-way, participatory shopping experience, let's get together to drive the new economy.

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions, Inc. offers a competitive salary and generous benefits package including the following:
bullets: Point-of-sale, retail technology, or enterprise commerce domain experience
Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools and clear articulation of governance and quality standards around its use
Experience creating or directing clickable prototypes as part of a product definition process
Experience operating within a defined portfolio governance model — prioritization rubrics, capacity tradeoffs, and formal change control
Experience managing a portfolio of offerings where prioritization and resource allocation must be defended
Group health coverage (medical, dental, & vision)
Employee Assistance Programs
Pre-tax spending accounts

greenhouse:vannevarlabs:5293446007.summary:
Vannevar builds AI systems for the Department of War's most consequential missions. We have 125 deployments across every branch and combatant command spanning our core platform and five distinct products. An an example of how we work, when major combat operations started with Iran, we fielded a new product supporting 24/7 operations and 9,000+ users in three months.

How we build is our advantage: we deploy forward with the people who own the mission. Our engineers, product team, and CTO deploy forward to the point of friction, including visiting units in Ukraine. We focus on embedding directly with operational units supporting great power competition with China, combat operations with Iran, and counter-narcotics missions.

sections.title: ABOUT THE ROLE
paras: We’re hiring a Product Manager for our Digital Investigations team.

This team builds AI-driven intelligence capabilities that turn large, messy, real-world datasets into clear answers and actions for operators and investigators. The product has strong traction and has been proven in real-world environments, and now we’re looking for a PM to chart the future of the product.

This is not a traditional roadmap role. You will take in incomplete, conflicting inputs from users, customers, stakeholders, and the product itself, and decide what we should build – and what we shouldn’t – as demand accelerates.

sections.title: WHAT YOU’LL DO
bullets: Own the product direction end-to-end. Turn ambiguous problems into concrete bets and drive them through to shipped capability.

Turn signal into direction. Take messy, often conflicting input from users, stakeholders, and the product itself, decide what actually matters for growth and mission impact, and translate it into clear product direction – including pushing back when the loudest ask isn’t the right one.
Build alignment across Mission and Engineering. Bring people along when Mission and Engineering see a problem differently – disagree when you need to, then get everyone committed on the path forward.
Partner with engineering. Embed with the team, meet them where they work best, and shape solutions that are both impactful and technically sound.
Work directly with users. Build deep intuition for real-world workflows and needs.
Drive adoption and durability. Move users from first use to daily reliance and keep quality high as volume grows.

sections.title: WHAT YOU SHOULD HAVE
bullets: Strong product judgment. You consistently identify the right problems and make sound prioritization decisions.
Ability to separate signal from noise. You form independent, defensible opinions from incomplete and conflicting inputs, and can act on them under uncertainty.
Experience operating under real constraints. You’ve shipped products where security, infrastructure, or deployment realities shaped decisions.
High ownership and a bias toward action. You take responsibility for outcomes and push work through to completion.
Technical fluency. You can engage with engineers and understand system constraints and tradeoffs.
Clear, direct communication. You can articulate decisions, tradeoffs, and reasoning in a way others can act on.
Active TS/SCI clearance (or ability to obtain one)
Willingness to travel onsite

sections.title: Nice to have
bullets: Experience working with operational, mission-driven, or investigative users
Experience with LLM-based systems
Experience with product analytics (e.g., SQL)
Experience rapidly prototyping ideas (Figma, AI coding tools, etc.)
Experience with digital investigations or targeting
Exposure to constrained or high-security environments

greenhouse:vercel:6210353004.summary:
Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

sections.title: About the role
paras: As a Product Manager, Software Factory, you’ll own a new product area that puts AI agents on every stage of the development loop: triaging an issue, planning it, writing the code, and checking the result, while keeping people on the judgment calls. Human time and attention are now the bottleneck, and the opportunity is to automate continuous software maintenance and improvement. You’ll define how agents help fix bugs, implement features, improve performance, mitigate security issues, improve code quality, and increase test coverage. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, in the office on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday.

sections.title: What you'll do
bullets: Own the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for Software Factory
Define the workflow model: how work moves through classification, analysis, implementation, and review, and where the handoff back to a person belongs

Own the trust and quality bar (evals, verification, retry behavior, and what the factory may touch without human approval) and shape the memory and context model that lets a factory build up knowledge of a repository over time

Define how factories integrate with where engineering work already lives, including GitHub and Linear, and with agent harnesses such as Codex and Claude Code, and define new dedicated surfaces for interacting with factory agents
Work directly with design partners and Enterprise customers adopting factories against their own codebases

sections.title: What you need
bullets: 8+ years of product management experience, including developer tooling products (ideally CI/CD, code review, developer productivity, or AI coding tools)
Used coding agents hands-on, and can describe where they succeed and where they fail today
Technical depth in agent orchestration, evals, context management, and sandboxed execution
Owned a platform area that other product teams build on, and set technical direction others adopted
Worked on products with probabilistic output, defining acceptance bars and measuring quality over time
Worked directly with design partners or Enterprise customers on adopting new engineering workflows

sections.title: Bonus if you
bullets: Have worked on multi-agent systems or agent orchestrators
Have worked on products adopted bottom-up by individual developers before spreading to teams
Have run or operated a large open-source project

greenhouse:veterinaryemergencygroupst:61.summary:
In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

sections.title: ABOUT VEG
paras: This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.
VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

sections.title: THE JOB
paras: As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say YES and put pets and customers experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

sections.title: WHAT YOU’LL DO
bullets: Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online
Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly
Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs
Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate
Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience
Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions
Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information
Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

sections.title: WHAT YOU NEED
bullets: 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
Advanced proficiency in computer programs and practice management software
Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
Strong communication skills; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
The ability to multitask and thrive amid chaos
High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly
Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments
Problem solving skills and a focus on innovation

greenhouse:wallstreetprep:8924040002.summary:
Location: New York, New York (Hybrid, 2-3 days per week in office)

Reporting to: Global Head of Account Management

Compensation: $85,000 - $95,000 base salary + bonus potential

sections.title: Position Summary
paras: The Customer Success Manager (CSM) serves as a key member of our Customer Success team and is responsible for managing and growing relationships with Wall Street Prep’s corporate clients. The CSM acts as the primary point of contact throughout the customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal and expansion, helping drive revenue growth while ensuring clients realize maximum value from Wall Street Prep’s training solutions.

This role plays a critical part in account retention, client satisfaction, and business expansion across financial institutions and Fortune 1000 companies. The ideal candidate thrives in novel, high-stakes situations that require creativity, intuition, and strategic thinking. The CSM will work closely with senior leaders at Wall Street Prep as well as decision-makers at global financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies to ensure successful adoption, retention, and growth across a portfolio of accounts.

sections.title: Customer Success & Account Management
bullets: Serve as the primary point of contact and build long-term relationships with corporate customers spanning financial institutions and Fortune 1000 companies.
Own the client renewal cycle and develop strategies to retain and grow existing business.
Identify opportunities to increase Wall Street Prep’s footprint and business within existing accounts.
Develop and maintain account plans and monitor overall account health across a portfolio of corporate clients.
Lead quarterly business review sessions and strategic account planning meetings with clients.
Ensure the timely and successful delivery of Wall Street Prep’s online and live training solutions according to customer needs and expectations.
Forecast and track key account metrics on a monthly and quarterly basis.
Serve as the voice of the customer internally and advocate for client needs across the organization.

sections.title: Client Engagement & Business Growth
bullets: Collaborate with the Business Development team to onboard new clients and support expansion opportunities.
Build relationships with senior HR leaders, business line executives, and key stakeholders within client organizations.
Identify and navigate organizational structures to uncover new revenue opportunities.
Partner closely with the Chief Revenue Officer and Managing Director to develop and execute account growth strategies.
Work cross-functionally with internal teams, instructors, and stakeholders to deliver a best-in-class client experience.
Serve as a liaison between customers and internal teams to ensure alignment and successful program execution.

sections.title: Required Skills
bullets: Demonstrated success managing client relationships and driving account retention and growth.
